key: alien breed (1991)(team 17)(disk 1 of 2)/Alien Breed (1991)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: wait_raster_then_clear_memory
description: Makes a library call, then counts down a pause in which each step waits for the video beam to reach scan line 32 by polling the vertical position register. Afterwards it zeroes 32-bit longwords downward from a global base in an endless loop.

key: adventures of robin hood, the (1991)(millennium)(m4)[cr skr]/Adventures of Robin Hood, The (1991)(Millennium)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: load_disk_data_and_init
description: Fills a disk read request for 23040 bytes from a fixed offset into a load address, submits it through a device call, then zeroes 81 longwords, copies 31 longwords into place and calls a routine. It then returns that routine's result.

name: decode_table_coded_rows
description: When a block counter expires, unpacks 16 rows of words from a byte stream, each value being a byte plus or minus a lookup-table entry, written at a fixed row stride. The stream is marked finished once the row count runs out.

key: 5th gear (1988)(hewson)[cr vf]/5th Gear (1988)(Hewson)[cr VF].adf:bootblock:0:000C

key: runtime segment $005740-$005A90:0:0004
name: advance_frame_and_load_palette
description: When a flag bit is set, advances a frame counter modulo 32 and points the first bitplane at the matching frame spaced 68 bytes apart. It copies sixteen palette words into the colour registers, sets four bitplane pointers spaced 8000 bytes apart and calls two further routines.

key: runtime segment $005740-$005A90:0:02C6
name: decode_joystick_direction_flags
description: Builds joystick direction and fire flags from the port values by XOR-ing adjacent bits of the two axis lines. As decompiled, the input is zeroed before the tests, so the routine only ends up setting the top flag bit.

key: runtime segment $037150-$037430:0:000A
name: chain_to_inner_routine
description: Calls one further routine and returns the register values that routine leaves. It contains no logic of its own.

key: runtime segment $037150-$037430:0:010A
name: update_audio_voices_each_tick
description: Each tick it counts down note timers and calls a lookup routine to set period and volume for the four Paula audio channels, writing those registers directly. When the mute flag is set it zeroes all four volumes and skips the update.

key: runtime segment $037150-$037430:0:02AE
name: decode_bitstream_back_references
description: Reads a bit stream and either copies literal bytes or repeats earlier output at a computed distance and length, writing backwards through the buffer. The decompiler marks the tail as bad instruction data, so the end of the routine is not reliable.

key: alianator (1991)(p.s.)(pd)/Alianator (1991)(P.S.)(PD).adf:Alianator:0:0000

name: set_interrupt_and_dma_registers
description: Writes the interrupt enable and DMA control registers using the set-when-bit-15 convention and reads the vertical position register. It is entered through a handler pointer stored in data, is reached from two places and calls one further routine.

key: alianator (1991)(p.s.)(pd)/Alianator (1991)(P.S.)(PD).adf:Alianator:0:056E
name: set_background_colour_register
description: Writes the background colour register and calls one further routine. It is entered through a handler address stored in data and called from one other routine.

key: alianator (1991)(p.s.)(pd)/Alianator (1991)(P.S.)(PD).adf:Alianator:0:05AA
name: forward_call_from_two_sites
description: Calls one further routine and is itself called from two places. The evidence records no hardware or library use for it and no pseudo-code, so nothing more is described.

key: alianator (1991)(p.s.)(pd)/Alianator (1991)(P.S.)(PD).adf:Alianator:0:05E6
name: jump_through_vector_entry
description: Calls one further routine through a jump-table entry that passes control straight on to a fixed address. It is called from one other routine.

description: Calls the depacker's bit-refill and bit-read routines to pull variable-width fields from a packed stream, and is entered from the boot entry. The body is not recovered, so the exact unpacking is not described.

key: uridium 2 (1993)(renegade)(disk 1 of 2)[cr tlc][t +28 atx][hd]/Uridium 2 (1993)(Renegade)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr TLC][t +28 ATX][HD].adf:bootblock:0:000C

description: Copies a 128-longword table to a fixed address, then loops over raw track buffers searching for the sector sync pattern and decoding each sector through a further routine. It decrements a sector count until it reaches zero and calls one further routine.

name: select_half_or_input

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:00C4

name: store_handler_in_offset_slot

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:0114
name: divide_by_eleven_and_loop
description: Divides an input value by eleven, storing the remainder and a base address in globals. It then loops over the quotient, calling routines and writing a red shade to the background colour register when a counter reaches zero.

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:0168
name: find_sector_sync_for_track
description: Locates the sector sync word in the track buffer, reads the sector number and, for numbers below twelve, searches the matching 1088-byte block for a sync word before calling a routine. It returns zero when no sync word is found.

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:01DA
name: verify_sector_checksums
description: Repeats a checksum test over 128 pairs of longwords, XOR-ing them together and comparing the masked result with a stored value. It returns 1 when every repetition matches and 0 otherwise.

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:0234
name: combine_masked_odd_even_bits
description: Combines two words under a mask by keeping the masked bits of the second input and adding the masked bits of the first shifted left by one. The pairing matches the odd and even bit-field recombination used in MFM decoding.

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:023E
name: copy_words_with_wrap_count
description: Copies 16-bit words from a source buffer to a destination in a loop, stopping when a remaining byte count reaches zero and saving the updated pointers and count otherwise. It returns true when the count has not yet reached zero.

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:0280
name: seek_disk_head_to_zero
description: Sets the DMA control register, waits on the disk status bit, then pulses the drive step line while the track-zero sensor is not reported. It calls a routine on each step.

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:02DA
name: deselect_drives_disable_disk_dma
description: Sets the drive-control bits on the disk port to deselect the drives, then clears the disk DMA enable bit in the DMA control register.

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:030A

key: 3d world boxing (1992)(simulmondo)(m4)[cr skr]/3D World Boxing (1992)(Simulmondo)(M4)[cr SKR].adf:bootblock:0:03A0
